name: replicate
title: Replicate
description: Replicate is a tool for creating and sharing machine learning models. This extension allows you to create and view your predictions in Raycast.
author: KevinBatdorf

commands.name: manage-ai-models
commands.title: Raycast AI Models
commands.subtitle: Replicate
commands.description: Choose which Replicate models appear in Raycast AI's model picker.

tools.name: list-models
tools.title: List Image Models
tools.description: List the image models in the user's Raycast AI model picker, with what each one does, whether it edits images or needs one, and the user's default model. Use Search Models to look beyond these.

tools.name: search-models
tools.title: Search Models
tools.description: Search all of Replicate for image models matching a query, with what each one does, whether it edits images, and whether it's already in the user's picker. Ask the user before running one that isn't.

tools.name: describe-model
tools.title: Describe Model
tools.description: Get a Replicate model's inputs — names, types, allowed values, bounds and defaults — so Start Image Generation can set them.

tools.name: start-generation
tools.title: Start Image Generation
tools.description: Run an image model on Replicate. Takes a prompt, optionally an image URL to edit and any of the model's other inputs. Waits up to five seconds and returns the finished image if it's ready, otherwise an id for Check Image Generation.

tools.name: check-generation
tools.title: Check Image Generation
tools.description: Check on an image started with Start Image Generation. Waits up to ten seconds, then returns the finished image, or its progress if it's still running.

ai.instructions: To make or edit an image: unless the user names a model, call list-models and use its default, or when there's no default pick the model whose description best fits. If none fits, call search-models, tell the user which model you'd use and why, and wait for them to agree before running it. When the user asks for something beyond the prompt, like a seed, a style strength or a file format, call describe-model and pass those as `inputs`. To change an existing image, use a model that edits images and pass the image's URL as `image`: an earlier result's URL or one the user pasted. These tools can't receive an image attached to the chat. If the user attached one and wants it used, say so, and ask them to paste its URL or pick an editing model like google/nano-banana in Raycast AI's model picker, which can use attachments. Then call start-generation. If its result has `markdown`, the image is done. Otherwise call check-generation with the id, again and again, until it's done or fails; each check waits up to ten seconds. Don't reply between these calls: a reply ends your turn and the image never arrives. When it's done, reply with the `markdown` field exactly as given: the user can't see the image any other way. Replicate models are written as owner/name; never invent one.

preferences.name: saveImages
preferences.title: Image History
preferences.label: Save generated images on this computer
preferences.description: Replicate deletes a prediction's files about an hour after it runs. With this on, images the extension generates are copied to this computer so View Predictions can still show them. The copies don't sync to other devices.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: The model @replicate uses for images, written as owner/name. Leave it empty to let the AI pick from your Raycast AI models.

preferences.name: confirmGenerations
preferences.title: AI Tool
preferences.label: Confirm before generating
preferences.description: Ask for confirmation before the AI tool runs a model and bills your Replicate account.

preferences.name: popularModels
preferences.title: AI Models
preferences.label: Offer popular models
preferences.description: List Replicate's most-run official image models in Raycast AI's model picker, refreshed daily. Models you add or chat with stay either way.
